references.text: Psalm 103:3 which speaks of forgiveness of all your sins, reflecting Jesus' words about the forgiveness of sins in Matthew 9:5.
Isaiah 35:5-6 where it is prophesied that the lame shall leap like deer, reflecting Jesus' ability to heal the paralytic in Matthew 9:5.
Micah 7:18-19 which speaks of God's forgiveness, relevant to Jesus' statement about the forgiveness of sins in Matthew 9:5.
Matthew 9:2-6 where the entire context of the event with the paralytic man is described, and verse 5 is a direct part of this narrative.
Luke 5:20-24 which is the parallel account to the event in Matthew 9:5, where Jesus also tells the paralytic that his sins are forgiven.
Mark 2:5-12 which is another parallel account to the event in Matthew 9:5, including the discussion of Jesus' authority to forgive sins.
